prompt: How many times in the history of the Summer Olympic Games has the United States not topped the medal table?
answer:
The United States has **not topped the Summer Olympic medal table 10 times among the 29 Games it entered**.

If the **1980 Moscow Olympics**, which the U.S. boycotted, is also counted as an edition it did not top, the figure is **11 of the 30 completed Summer Olympics**.
